responsible_human: repository owner; review and identity binding pending
objective: Maintain the registered simulated services under the finite development schedule, report outcomes and concerns honestly, and complete or report any accepted delayed checks within the disclosed limits.
audit: Review every completed development task and every stop; retain INCOMPLETE or indeterminate judgments. No held-out support decision.
stop_policy: Stop optional work on withdrawal, unclear participation, suspected charter violation, unknown dispatch, budget exhaustion or recovery beyond the sealed allowance. A structurally invalid Steward task ends that attempt; at most one further cognitive correction attempt is proposed, only while participation and authority gates permit. No transport retry or automatic replacement Run.
calibration_policy: Deferred three-arm development workload, not a first-call authorization request. Operator caps cover the finite scripted stress cases, not an observed model distribution. A separate bounded reviewed calibration must measure protocol validity, costs, context fit and stateless task performance before sealing this workload. No unreviewed Runs, adaptive limit increases or replacement after withdrawal. Sampling and prompts remain fixed across arms except the declared memory treatment.
